Definition: to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to depart, remove; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to depart; 1a2) to remove; 1a3) to be removed (of inanimate objects); 1b) (Hiphil) to remove, depart
